title: 3rd degree AV block rx'ed with a ventricular pacemaker | Health Education Assets Library (HEAL)
description: In A the ECG shows complete or 3rd degree AV block with a left ventricular escape rhythm, as evidenced by the upright QRS morphology.  In B the artificial right ventricular pacemaker rhythm is shown.

title: Wandering atrial pacemaker | Health Education Assets Library (HEAL)
description: Wandering atrial pacemaker is a benign rhythm change where the pacemaker site shifts from the sinus node into the atrial tissues.  P-wave morphology varies with the pacemaker site.

title: Ventricular pacemaker rhythm | Health Education Assets Library (HEAL)
description: Note the small pacemaker spikes before the QRS complexes in many of the leads.  In addition, the QRS complex in V1 exhibits ventricular ectopic morphology; i.e., there is a slur or notch at the beginning of the S wave, and>60ms delay from onset to QRS to nadir of S wave.  This rules against a supraventricular rhythm with LBBB.
